task: Add `List.partition` to src/List.ts and export it through the `List` object. It takes a predicate `(x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean` and a list, and returns a `Tuple` whose first element is the array of elements the predicate accepted and whose second is the array of elements it rejected, both in their original order, so that `List.partition(x => x > 1, [1, 2, 3])` equals `Tuple([2, 3], [1])` and `List.partition(x => x > 1, [])` equals `Tuple([], [])`. It is curried the same way `List.find` is: called with the predicate alone it returns a function of the list. Give it the same two overloads and a doc comment in the style of the file, and add tests for it in src/List.test.ts. Keep every existing test passing.
